note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated India customs export records with destination, HS 73239390 and B/L numbers (9831820 Mexico 2024-05-13; 9763946 Spain 2024-05-10; 9708000 Canada 2024-05-08; 9677947 Netherlands 2024-05-07). Declared HS 732393 matches the actual export HS 73239390 (stainless-steel kitchen/household articles) — no HS discrepancy. The company is also an importer of raw material (non-magnetic SS cold-rolled coil, HS 72199090, from China, B/L 3561678, 2024-05-19), i.e. it converts imported coil into finished SS articles for export — a manufacturer-exporter profile, not a pure trader. Address on record: "11, SSI ESTATE, G.T. KARNAL ROAD" (Delhi), which does not match the claimed state Haryana — worth flagging as a data-quality note, not a rejection ground. Industry claim "Продукты питания и FMCG" (food/FMCG) is inconsistent with the actual product line (stainless-steel utensils/kitchenware); the HS code is correct as declared, the industry label should be corrected to metals/houseware.
